name: discord-bridge
description: Posts progress and reports to Discord and takes questions and commands from a channel, through the mods-hub channel system.

botToken.title: Bot token
botToken.description: Your Discord bot's token (a secret). Needed to read the channel, ask and take commands. Optional here: export DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN instead.

channelId.title: Channel id
channelId.description: The one channel to post to and read (digits; Developer Mode → right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID). The bot needs View Channel and Read Message History there. Also /discord channel <id>.

ownerId.title: Owner user id
ownerId.description: Your Discord user id (digits): the only one that can command Claude, answer or approve. Everyone else in the channel may only ask. Also /discord owner <id>.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (post only)
webhookUrl.description: A channel webhook URL (a secret). With only this, Claude posts to the channel but cannot read it, ask or take commands. Optional: export DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL instead.

notifyMode.title: When to notify (without a hub)
notifyMode.description: Only used while mods-hub does not answer: off silences the channel; anything else posts team news.

interaction.title: Interaction (without a hub)
interaction.description: Only used while mods-hub does not answer: may Claude ask you things. auto = only while you are away.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes, without a hub)
awayMinutes.description: Only used without the hub: minutes without typing after which you count as away.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours (without a hub)
quietHours.description: Only used without the hub: hours when nothing is asked, like 23-8 (empty: none).

pin.title: PIN
pin.description: A PIN that "stop all" from the channel needs (a secret; empty: none).

confirmPrompts.title: Confirm prompts from the channel
confirmPrompts.description: Ask "Run this?" (reply yes / no, or react ✅ / ❌) before a prompt from Discord starts a turn (only when Interaction allows questions).

remoteApprovals.title: Answer permission prompts from the channel
remoteApprovals.description: While you are away and Interaction allows it, permission prompts are posted for you to answer with yes / no or a reaction.

memberTrigger.title: Member trigger words
memberTrigger.description: Channel members' messages starting with one of these (comma-separated) are questions for Claude; @mentions of the bot count too.

shareCodeWithMembers.title: Share code with members
shareCodeWithMembers.description: Let answers to members include short code snippets.

maxMessageChars.title: Message length cap
maxMessageChars.description: Longest text posted, in characters (Discord allows 2000).

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the polling session reads the channel while you are away or a question is open (three times slower otherwise).
